newsitem.title: UK: Carclo buys EIS unit for 25.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Carclo buys EIS unit for 25.6 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Carclo Engineering Group Plc said on Thursday it agreed to buy the Technical Mouldings division of EIS Group Plc for 25.6 million stg in cash.
The division, which produces speciality components for original equipment manufacturers, had operating profits of 3.0 million stg before charges on turnover of 37.0 million stg in 1996.
Carclo said the acquisition complemented its strategic focus on technical plastics and re-balanced its portfolio of businesses toward this growth market.
For its part, EIS said the sale was part of its strategy to focus on its two key market sectors of equipment for the oil and petrochemical industries and for aerospace and defence.
Carclo shares were marked up 9.0p at 200 by 0925 GMT, while EIS shares dipped 1.0p to 352.5 -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
